name: button
description: Primary action button — variant (filled/outline/ghost) × color (primary/secondary/destructive/success/warning/neutral/inherit) × intensity (solid/soft). Sizes determine padding/typography. Supports iconOnly mode, leading/trailing icon slots, loading state. Slottable composition for asChild alongside icons. `intensity` picks the strength of the family `color` selects: solid is the base role, soft its container — the same axis Badge carries, so the two answer to one vocabulary. `inherit` reads currentColor and ignores intensity, having no family: use it for an icon affordance on a coloured surface that must take the parent’s foreground, and, with variant=ghost, for a button whose appearance the consumer’s own class owns — that pair paints nothing, which is what loom.base already gives a bare button. It still carries data-size, so it takes its tier’s height, padding and action font; markup hand-written as `button interactive control` takes none of those.
